description: Land Acquisition - Siyanbaladamana Palugaswewa D/S Division, Anuradhapura District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels, their boundaries, and extents in a designated area. While it mentions a government minister (Harin Fernando) issuing the order, the core content is exclusively about land acquisition procedures and property descriptions, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4) rather than a government personnel or structural gazette.
